lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits are arranged in a grid-like configuration. These spots form vertical clusters of approximately 3 to 4 units each, spaced horizontally along the lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a series of high-contrast nodes that define the grid structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition where the dorsal edge of the ridge is highlighted and the ventral edge is in shadow.
